prompt:
Image 1 is only a palette and art-style reference (Hiro the traveling swordsman: brown leather, a dull green cloak, a plain iron sword). Do NOT draw the character or the sword.

Create an 8-frame spell VFX sprite sheet, one continuous sequence centred in every cell: the FINISHING CROSS CUT of a swordsman, an X of two crossing plain steel cuts, then a puff of dust and a few leaves. Frame 1: one off-white cut line slashed diagonally. Frame 2: the second line crosses it into an X. Frame 3: the X at its sharpest with short impact lines. Frame 4: a dust puff bursting from the centre. Frame 5: dust spreading, a few leaves flying. Frame 6: the X fading. Frame 7: dust thinning. Frame 8: a few specks and leaves.
PLAIN and MODEST: this is the free starter hero, so the effect is simple and down to earth. Painted as OPAQUE solid shapes with crisp edges: no glow halo, no haze, no sparkles, no gold light, no jewels, no rainbow colours, no magic runes. No pink, no purple, no magenta tint. Colours only white, steel grey, sandy beige, dull green leaves.
Exactly 8 frames in a 4 columns x 2 rows grid of equal square 512x512 cells, total image 2048x1024, read left-to-right then next row. Nothing crosses a cell edge; leave a magenta margin of at least 6% on all sides of every cell. Background 100% solid flat #FF00FF magenta in every cell, no gradient, no text, no labels, no borders, no gridlines. Clean HD smooth painted anime game VFX, NOT pixel art.

precheck.summary: The sheet has 8 frames in a 4x2 grid on a flat magenta background, with no text, borders, or extra figures. The sequence follows the prompt: a single cut, an X, impact lines, dust, fading, and leaves. The image is about 1024x512 rather than the requested 2048x1024, so each cell is about 256px instead of 512px. This does not make the frames unusable as raw material.
